g.text: The order is not arbitrary. The source inventory (5) comes before the parser (6) so the denominator cannot be derived from the thing under test. The
archive-mirror row is written last of all, after the object has been uploaded, read back, hashed and size-checked, because that row is what the
Ingestion has no REST trigger. The only way a law enters the pipeline is a matching Kafka event, which is what makes replay and re-ingest the same
